BiblicalUsage: Blackness is the colour of famine. Lamentations says their visage is blacker than a coal, they are not known in the streets, their skin cleaves to their bones and is withered like a stick. One verse carries the whole word, and it is a verse of starvation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this verse is meant to be seen, not explained away, for hunger blackened their faces, and I hold that God records such suffering because He does not forget it.
